title: Manual reassignment of claims
walkthroughSteps: Your own claim: Reassign beside Assigned Claim handler. Pick a handler or a team queue, confirm, toast.
A colleague's claim in your team: Take claim. Another team's claim, or one above your authority: the line says why and who can move it.
Both handlers hear about it in the bell, and both claims lists change straight away.
Registering a claim: the Summary step shows who gets it, with Change handler.
Several claims at once (before leave): claims list, tick them, Reassign.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC01 · Reassign during registration, before completing
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** FNOL Summary step as Mara Mustermann.

**You see:** In General configurations: **Claim handler: Mara Mustermann (you)** with **Change handler**.

**Try:** Press Change handler, pick Lena Zorn (or A team queue), Choose: the line shows Lena with "They will be notified when you submit" and **Keep it myself** to undo. Going Back a step and returning keeps the pick; a new notification starts from you again. Submit: every claim the notification creates is Lena's, the reason is in its activity log, the toast says "Assigned to Lena Zorn. They have been notified." and the line reads **Lena Zorn** "They have been notified." without Change handler.

Decision: by default a new claim goes to the handler registering it (rule-based routing comes with a later epic). No confirm here: nothing is saved before Submit, and Submit is the commit (DESIGN DECISION RA-FNOL-1).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC02 · Reassign your own claim to an eligible handler or team, with confirm
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-025 as Mara Mustermann (her claim).

**You see:** **Reassign** beside Assigned Claim handler. The dialog has **A handler / A team queue**, a search, and the list. Sabine Rand is greyed out: "Out of office until 28-11-2026".

**Try:** Pick Lena Zorn, add a reason, press Reassign: a confirm pops up over the dialog, Yes, reassign: toast, the handler field and activity log update.

Decision: handler or team is one radio choice above one list; people who can't take the claim stay visible with the reason (DESIGN DECISION RA-PICK-1). Eligible = any handler in a team, or any team queue. Over 500,000, handlers without the authority are greyed out "Above their handling authority".

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC03 · Not allowed: another team's claim
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-009 (Georg Stein, Marine team) as Mara Mustermann.

**You see:** No Take claim. Instead, under the handler: "Held by the Marine and liability team. Ask Marcus Fehr (team manager) to move it to you."

**Try:** Compare with AC-05 (authority).

Decision: you can reassign your own claims; a Claims Manager also anything their team holds; KCM anything open. A handler can take a claim held by their own team, within their authority (DESIGN DECISION RA-AUTH-2 / RA-AUTH-3).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC03 · Not allowed: above your authority
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-005 (Property team queue, EUR 999,999,999) as Mara Mustermann.

**You see:** "Above your handling authority (up to EUR 500,000). Ask Tobias Grau (team manager) to assign it."

**Try:** Switch to Tobias Grau (Manager): he gets Reassign on the same claim.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** the authority model is not defined in the ticket. Implemented as a loss amount ceiling: handlers up to 500,000, managers and KCM no ceiling, no currency conversion (DESIGN DECISION RA-AUTH-1). Treated as `done` pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC04 · Previous and new handler are notified, both worklists update
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Dashboard as Tobias Grau (Manager).

**You see:** Team workload with Nina Feld's claims.

**Try:** View claims of Nina Feld, row menu on CLM-2024-022 > Reassign > Mara Mustermann > confirm ("will move from Nina Feld to Mara Mustermann. Mara Mustermann and Nina Feld will be notified"). Switch to Mara: the bell has "CLM-2024-022 was assigned to you by Tobias Grau" under Needs you, and Claims portfolio (My claims) lists it at the top. Switch back to Tobias: Nina's count is one lower, Mara's one higher. The handler who loses a claim gets "CLM-... was moved to ... by ..." under Someone else is on it.

Bulk moves send one notification per person ("3 claims were assigned to you"), not one per claim. A team queue target notifies the team manager. Notifications live for the browser session only (prototype).

**Try:** Your pick and reason are kept; press Reassign again.

Decision: the confirm pops up over the dialog; a failed save keeps the dialog and the choice (DESIGN DECISION RA-PICK-2).

acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claims list filtered to your claims, as Mara.

**You see:** Tick claims (or Select all), press Reassign: the dialog lists them in a table. Selected claims that aren't yours are left out with a note.

**Try:** Reassign to Lena: toast "5 claims reassigned", the list refreshes, Lena gets one notification.

Decision: bulk reassignment is in scope on the claims list, using the same dialog and rules; a foreign claim in the selection is skipped, not a blocker (DESIGN DECISION RA-BULK-1).
